Blam! Machinehead.name: Blam! Machinehead
Blam! Machinehead.summary: Blam! Machinehead, known in the US as Machine Head, is an action shooting game developed by Core Design and published by Virgin Interactive for the Sega Saturn, MS-DOS, and PlayStation in 1996.

Tournament Leader.name: The Scottish Open: Carnoustie Virtual Golf
Tournament Leader.summary:
In the golf simulator you are allowed to win in Scottish Open on Championship Golf Courses, including The Bowery, Kilmarney, Penperro, and Carnoustie. There are many players in the game, who can rise during the playing. You can choose, edit or create one of them. Choosing a club, striking a ball, and counting turns, you have to beat your opponents, taking into account wind and height of landscape.

The game employs 3 different camera angles to capture the most realistic aspect on the course.

World Cup Golf - In Hyatt Dorado Beach.name: World Cup Golf: Professional Edition
World Cup Golf - In Hyatt Dorado Beach.summary:
Take on the best with WORLD CUP GOLF: Professional Edition. Get onto the green in the Practice mode, and work on any hole that gives you problems. In Normal mode, challenge the course alone or play against someone with 15 different game types such as skins and match play.

Tournament mode provides you with the ability to create your own event. No matter how you play the course, you'll have full control over your player's stance as well as the weather and the ground conditions. While you play, your auditory sense is treated to CD quality music and digitized speech. See how long you would last as an expert in WORLD CUP GOLF: Professional Edition.
